summary: Fossil Group filed an 8-K announcing the date (October 2, 2026) and record date (August 3, 2026) for its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, along with updated deadlines for stockholder proposals and director nominations under its bylaws and Rule 14a-8. This is a routine administrative notice setting meeting logistics and submission windows; no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is described. The filing contains no deal terms.
